Pakistan's youth cricket,
run like a pro event

Flare Cricket Tournament 2026 is an under 19 indoor cricket tournament on 28 and 29 November 2026. Our goal is to make FCT one of Pakistan's most professionally organised youth cricket tournaments: a platform where young athletes compete, build their skills and experience high quality sporting competition.

This year's edition brings together 32 teams from schools, colleges and academies across the region.

Sport shapes character, leadership, discipline and teamwork. Beyond the excitement of the contest, FCT is built to connect students and encourage a culture of sportsmanship and excellence.

We would be honoured to welcome your institution and give your students a professionally managed, highly competitive stage to show their talent.

32Teams in a straight knockout

The yellow tape ball,
done properly

Tape ball is the game Pakistan grew up on: loud, fast and personal. FCT takes that raw energy and gives it the structure it has always deserved. Real organisation, real umpires, real prizes and a proper venue under lights.

Fast and fearless

A taped ball skids and swings. Bowlers attack, batters take chances, and matches turn in a single over.

Street spirit, pro standard

The cricket you play with friends, run with registered squads, umpires and a tournament committee.

Three overs of pure pressure

Knockout means one bad over can end a campaign. There is nowhere to hide and plenty to celebrate.

Built for young talent

An under 19 stage where schools, colleges and academies meet on equal ground.

Yellow beats white on turf

High quality yellow tape, every ball

FCT matches are played with a ball wrapped in high quality yellow tape. Good tape means a consistent bounce, grip and swing from the first over to the final, so matches are decided by skill and not by a worn or uneven ball.

Easier to see than white

It has been scientifically tested that a yellow tape ball is more easily seen than a white tape ball on turf. Against the green surface, yellow stands out with far stronger contrast, so batters pick up the delivery earlier, fielders track the ball in the air, and umpires and spectators follow every ball.

That means cleaner cricket, fairer decisions and a better show under daylight and floodlights alike.

Register your team

The team captain registers the whole squad of 8 players. Fill in the form and it opens as a ready-made WhatsApp message to the FCT team.

  1. Enter the team, institution and captain details.
  2. Add all 8 players with their phone numbers.
  3. Tap Send on WhatsApp and send the message.
  4. In the same chat, send a clear photo of each player's ID card.
  5. Pay the entry fee and send the screenshot to confirm.

Prefer email? Use Send by email and attach the ID card photos to the message.

Squad of 8

Every player must carry their ID card on tournament day. Only registered players can play.

Tournament rules

Everything teams, captains and supporters need to know. Tap a heading to open it.

General
  1. Each team has a captain, who registers all team members on the provided form.
  2. Matches are played on a knockout basis.
  3. Every team must complete registration before the deadline.
  4. Each team must submit a complete list of players before the tournament starts.
  5. No unregistered player will be allowed to play.
  6. All teams must report at the venue at the prescribed time.
  7. Arrival after the designated session time results in a walkover. Late arrival may also bring penalties or match forfeiture.
  8. Every participant must carry an ID card.
Conduct
  1. Abusive, offensive or inappropriate language is strictly prohibited.
  2. Any fighting, aggression or misconduct leads to immediate action.
  3. Umpire decisions are final and must be respected.
  4. Any cheating or rule violation results in disqualification.
  5. Vapes, cigarettes, perfumes, knives and similar items are strictly prohibited. Serious action will be taken if they are found.
  6. Fighting, abusive language, threats or misconduct towards opponents, officials or spectators brings penalty points on the team. The umpire and tournament management decide the number of points.
  7. Repeated misconduct after a penalty may lead to immediate disqualification.
  8. The tournament committee may remove any player or team whose behaviour damages the spirit of the competition.
Squad and fees
  1. Each team registers a squad of 8 players.
  2. Only 7 players may take the field during a match.
  3. The remaining player is a substitute who may field only. A substitute cannot bat or bowl unless organisers approve in exceptional circumstances.
  4. The umpire's decision is final and binding in all matters. Players, captains and spectators associated with a team must respect it at all times.
  5. Registration is confirmed only on receipt of the full entry fee.
  6. The entry fee is strictly non-refundable under any circumstances, including withdrawal, absence, player unavailability, weather or disqualification. It cannot be transferred.
  7. Organisers and appointed umpires have full authority to enforce the rules and maintain discipline.
  8. Any situation not covered here is decided by the tournament organisers, and their decision is final.
We want FCT to be where Pakistan's young cricketers meet a professional stage.
